set.descent: From M&M Ledge, work climber’s left to bolts and make four double-rope rappels down the East Face to the ground near your pack; or continue to the summit and take the standard Liberty Bell descent into the Liberty Bell-Concord notch, on the opposite side of the mountain.
set.rappels: 4 double-rope rappels from bolted anchors down the East Face, starting climber’s left of M&M Ledge
